name: Embedded Systems Specialist Examination
name_ja: エンベデッドシステムスペシャリスト試験 (ES)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (April)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded embedded and IoT depth plus national recognition support professional engineering responsibility valuable in manufacturing; security is only part of the scope, so expert cyber standing is not established.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded embedded and IoT depth with three years of experience supports professional engineering knowledge. The paper exam and partial security focus do not demonstrate practical OT incident response or cross-domain security leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded embedded and IoT depth supports professional systems work at a three-year level. Security is only part of the scope, and the supplied evidence does not demonstrate advanced practical offensive assessment.
